MakeTaskFlowInstanceSuccess.title: Set the status of a specified task flow to successful

ModifyDataCorrectExecSQL.title: Modify the SQL script of a data change ticket
ModifyDataCorrectExecSQL.summary: Modify the SQL script submitted in a data change ticket.

ModifyDesensitizationStrategy.title: ModifyDesensitizationStrategy
ModifyDesensitizationStrategy.summary: Modifies the masking rule bound to a specified field.

ModifyInstance.title: ModifyInstance
ModifyInstance.summary: Modifies the basic and advanced information about a database instance in Data Management (DMS). The basic information includes the hosting mode of the instance, the instance account username and password, and features that are enabled for the instance. The advanced information includes the environment type, the instance name in DMS, and the timeout period for querying and exporting data.

MountTableToCategory.title: Correct table folder mounting
MountTableToCategory.summary: Manually mounts a table to a specified business folder to correct an incorrect folder mounting. When Replace is set to true, existing folder relationships of the table are unbound first (remount).

MoveTaskFlowToScenario.title: Move a task flow to a specified business scenario
MoveTaskFlowToScenario.summary: Moves a task flow to a specified business scenario.

OfflineTaskFlow.title: OfflineTaskFlow
OfflineTaskFlow.summary: Unpublishes a published task flow in Data Management (DMS).

OptimizeSqlByMetaAgent.title: OptimizeSqlByMetaAgent
OptimizeSqlByMetaAgent.summary: Analyzes and optimizes the SQL statements in the specified database.

PauseDataCorrectSQLJob.title: PauseDataCorrectSQLJob
PauseDataCorrectSQLJob.summary: Pauses a SQL task for data change.

PauseDataExportJob.title: PauseDataExportJob
PauseDataExportJob.summary: Terminates a SQL result set export task.

PreviewWorkflow.title: PreviewWorkflow
PreviewWorkflow.summary: Previews the approval process of a ticket before the ticket is submitted.

PublishAndDeployTaskFlow.title: Publish and deploy a specified task flow
PublishAndDeployTaskFlow.summary: Publishes and deploys a specified task flow.

QueryDataTrackResultDownloadStatus.title: QueryDataTrackResultDownloadStatus

RegisterUser.title: RegisterUser
RegisterUser.summary: Adds a user of your enterprise.

RemoveTableFromCategory.title: RemoveTableFromCategory
RemoveTableFromCategory.summary: Removes table from the asset category.

RemoveWorkspaceUser.title: RemoveWorkspaceUser
RemoveWorkspaceUser.summary: Removes a user from a workspace.

RestartDataCorrectSQLJob.title: Retry a failed data change SQL job
RestartDataCorrectSQLJob.summary: Retry a data change SQL job that has already failed to execute.

RestartDataExportJob.title: RestartDataExportJob
RestartDataExportJob.summary: Restarts a SQL result set export task.

ResumeTaskFlowInstance.title: Resume a paused task flow

SearchDataTrackResult.title: SearchDataTrackResult

SearchInventoryAsset.title: SearchInventoryAsset

SearchInventoryKnowledge.title: SearchInventoryKnowledge
SearchInventoryKnowledge.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of knowledge generated by an inventory task. You can filter the results by keyword, knowledge type, and other criteria.

SearchTableAssetKnowledge.title: SearchTableAssetKnowledge
SearchTableAssetKnowledge.summary: Queries a paginated list of asset knowledge related to a specific table. This knowledge includes information about tables, columns, SQL statements, and snippets.

SetForecastAgentInstance.title: SetForecastAgentInstance

SkipDataCorrectRowCheck.title: Skip the row count validation in the data change precheck

SubmitStructSyncOrderApproval.title: SubmitStructSyncOrderApproval

UpdateTaskConfig.title: Update node advanced configuration
